# Grand Hotel Lahore: guest policies

## Cancellation policy

Reservations can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the check-in date.
Cancellations made less than 24 hours before check-in are charged one night's stay.
No-shows are charged the full booking amount.

## Check-in and check-out

Check-in starts at 2:00 PM and check-out is until 12:00 noon. Early check-in from 10:00 AM
can be arranged for a fee of PKR 3,000, subject to availability.

## Breakfast

A buffet breakfast is served in the Shalimar restaurant from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and is
included in all room rates.

## Pets

Pets are not allowed in the hotel, with the exception of trained service animals.

## Wi-Fi

Free high-speed Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and public areas. Ask the front desk for
the password.
